# Exact arrival boundary under partial correction

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every law of change with admissible disturbances and every target, a start reaches the target within n steps on every admissible disturbance exactly when some funnel holds it at level n (level 0 in the target; level k+1 in the target or sent by every admissible step to level k), and exactly when every basin does; reaching composes. For a determined law the orbit meets the target within n steps exactly when some funnel holds the start, and, the target decided, exactly when some numeric variant at most n at the start is lowered by every step outside the target; it never reaches the target exactly when some set containing the start avoids the target and is closed under the law, the viability kernel of the target's complement, and a fixed configuration outside the target is such a set. In the original rational market family with 0<=beta<=3/4 and zero extra quality error, every physical positive renewal state reaches the original protection region in finite time exactly when beta<=5/12: the market's gain estimates (share, then influence, then quality) supply the funnels into landing, the instance's content, and above 5/12 the fixed configuration is a closed set avoiding landing. Equivalently, the quality margin at 3/8 under the worst influence 1 is nonnegative, and no closed set avoiding landing contains a positive state. This includes equality and executes under the inherited initial stock cover K_N, handing the actual arrived state to original protection after withdrawal.

Canonical source: [PartialRegimeTransition.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/formal/PartialRegimeTransition.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Physical rational x,q,w in [0,1], x>0; beta remains fixed during the finite intervention, other example parameters persist, and additional quality error is zero.
- Actual execution additionally requires nonnegative per-step support consumption kappa and C0>=K_N; monetary payment precedes receipts, beta returns to 1/2 after handoff, kappa is withdrawn and there are no other shocks.

Critical recovery depends on renewal actually changing subsequent influence; parameter, share, support and quality-reading correspondence must be established. Existing formation results are not yet formally mapped to market shares or beta change.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 actually checks 26 new theorems / 31 declaration audits and separately 123 inherited theorems / 153 audits. Author counterreview is integrated, without independent agent acceptance or new market observations. General laws: checker receipts bound.

The exact boundary concerns the specified zero-error universal positive-state arrival property, not a complete basin, all-parameter bifurcation, noisy recovery range, measured threshold, or formed intervention/entry.

- Above criticality there is a positive fixed obstruction and a positive-width nonarrival box. At criticality arbitrarily small constant adverse error has positive fixed obstructions; their stability is not claimed.
